info.title: KMail API
info.description:
KMail module API, maintained in its own repository.

GENERATED from "KPOST API (6).xlsx" by scripts/excel-to-contract.cjs — do not edit by hand.
Only rows with a real path and a known HTTP method are included; superseded (yellow), duplicate and legacy rows are excluded and listed in contracts/_conversion-report.json.
Schemas are inferred from the documented examples, so no property is marked required, and the workbook documents no status codes or auth requirements.

Hello,

We are currently performing bulk mail functionality testing to ensure smooth and reliable communication. This is a test message to verify that emails are being delivered successfully.

If you have received this email, the system is working as expected.

Thank you for your time and cooperation.


Best regards,
Development Team
